segments.speaker: Operator
segments.text: Our next question comes from an analyst. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Analyst
segments.text: Thanks. Can you walk us through the change to the full-year outlook, and how much of it is North America?

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: Sure. We now expect core constant currency EPS growth of 1% to 2%, and core EPS growth of 2.5% to 3.5% for the year, versus the low end of our prior range.

claims.quote: We now expect core constant currency EPS growth of 1% to 2%
core EPS growth of 2.5% to 3.5% for the year

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: On the top line, organic revenue growth is now about 3%, and reported net revenue growth is about 6%, helped by foreign exchange.

claims.quote: organic revenue growth is now about 3%
reported net revenue growth is about 6%

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: We also now expect a core tax rate of about 21%.

claims.quote: a core tax rate of about 21%

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: The quarter benefited from roughly 178 million dollars of tariff refunds, and we expect North America margin pressure to continue into the fourth quarter.

claims.quote: we expect North America margin pressure to continue into the fourth quarter
roughly 178 million dollars of tariff refunds

segments.speaker: Ramon Laguarta (CEO)
segments.text: We'll give you the full 2027 picture in February. What I can say is we're investing in affordability and the portfolio transformation.

claims.quote: We'll give you the full 2027 picture in February

segments.speaker: Operator
segments.text: Our next question comes from another analyst.

segments.speaker: Analyst
segments.text: Just to confirm, the EPS growth for the year is now 2.5 to 3.5 percent?

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: That's right, 2.5% to 3.5% core EPS growth.

segments.speaker: Ramon Laguarta (CEO)
segments.text: Consumers remain value-seeking, and we're seeing that across the categories.

segments.speaker: Jamie Caulfield (CFO)
segments.text: Net revenue for the quarter was 25.27 billion dollars, up 5.6%.

segments.speaker: Operator
segments.text: Thank you. That concludes our question-and-answer session.
